about: CNOSSOS-EU point-source test cases TC01-TC28 of ISO/TR 17534-4:2020, direct path only, as published by NoiseModelling. cut_points: every profile vertex projected on the horizontal source-receiver line (s_m from the source); ground_g applies from that vertex to the next. Walls are building/barrier edge crossings with their top altitude. Levels are for the case sound_power_db in every octave band (93 dB; TC28 150 dB), 10 C, 70 % RH.

provenance.licence: NoiseModelling is GPL-3.0; the numeric test-case values originate from ISO/TR 17534-4:2020
